acceptanceCriteria: A guard (test or vet in CI) prevents untagged dispatch tests from using unix-only helpers again.
body: Found 2026-10-10 (dispatch flake lane, base origin/main 1786d9da). GOOS=windows go vet ./internal/tasks/dispatch fails: prompt_fragments_test.go:47: undefined: testConfig. The file has no build tag but testConfig is defined in a darwin||linux file. Same class as completed V1-0839, reintroduced by a later file. Expected: windows vet clean. Actual: undefined identifier.
title: Windows go vet of internal/tasks/dispatch fails again: prompt_fragments_test.go uses unix-only testConfig
